screening_decisions.reason: Not oral: clomipramine administered intravenously (does not meet orally administered criterion).
Not tricyclic: fluoxetine is an SSRI.
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of a tricyclic (nortriptyline) in depressed adolescents (12–17); oral dosing implied.
Not an RCT; narrative review, no randomized placebo-controlled tricyclic trial.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled pilot of imipramine in depressed children; oral tricyclic vs placebo.
Randomized double-blind crossover of oral amitriptyline vs placebo in depressed children (9–12).
Not tricyclic and not a primary RCT; review of newer antidepressants (SSRIs).
Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial of oral imipramine (with CBT) in adolescents with comorbid anxiety and major depressive disorder.
Double-blind, placebo-controlled study of oral imipramine in prepubertal major depressive disorder.
Randomized, double-blind trial including imipramine vs placebo arm in adolescents with major depression (oral tricyclic vs placebo).
Not an RCT; mechanistic review of antidepressants.
Not an RCT treating depression; review of SSRI overdose safety.
Not an RCT; methodological note on meta-analysis inconsistency.
Not an RCT of depression treatment; amitriptyline intoxication case series.
Not an RCT comparing oral tricyclic vs placebo; observational analysis of predictors.
Randomized, placebo-controlled trial of oral desipramine in adolescents with major depressive disorder.
Not an RCT; narrative review/commentary.

Not an RCT; accidental ingestions in children ≤6 years (wrong design and population).

Adults (18–65 years); wrong age group and not a pediatric RCT vs placebo.
Not randomized/placebo-controlled; plasma level–response correlation study.
